title.narrative: Strengthening rural women and young people's livelihood for a resilient and sustainable economic empowerment in Bombali and Kambia districts

description.narrative:
The Action addresses several key subthemes outlined in the call for proposals, as well as the priorities identified in the EU¿s Roadmap for engagement with Civil Society for Sierra Leone and the Multi-Annual Indicative Programme 2021-2027. The proposed Action contributes to strengthened civil society, promoting joint actions between CSOs and LAs, and fostering a Green Economy and Human Development. Thematically, the Action addresses multiple and cross-cutting SDGs: Goal 1 (No poverty), Goal 2 (Zero hunger), Goal 4 (Quality Education), Goal 5 (Gender Equality) and Goal 8 (Decent Work).

The Action contributes to the global objective of the call `to strengthen Civil Society Organisations¿ engagement as actors of good governance and development.¿ It aligns with the call's specific objectives and priorities related to the strengthened capacities of local CSOs to contribute to the implementation of development plans and to engage in gender equality and youth inclusion (lot 1). The Action will strengthen the resilience and livelihoods of rural women and young people through agribusiness development, financial inclusion, vocational skills, and career development. The project embeds a rights-based approach as it will enable people who have been excluded from engaging as active actors of inclusive and sustainable development. Including the rights and needs of women, youth and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) is central to the Action. Particularly, young people with disabilities will be targeted throughout the Action.
